late_entry_override_authorization: explicit user instruction: allow trades opening beyond fifteen minutes while repairing and verifying the restored hourly producer; one 17:00 UTC decision only
late_source_policy: one explicit decision-time exception only; all source, model, MC1 admission, live-book, execution-adjusted EV, price-move, portfolio and immediate protective-stop gates remain mandatory
execution_adjusted_ev: raw_expected_gross_bps - adverse_delay_gap_bps - max(80 bps, 1.2 * live_full_spread_bps + 2 * entry_impact_bps); raw_expected_gross_bps is the explicit MC1 gross convention and the historical 100-bps policy cost is not debited again; must remain at least +50 bps at preflight and after fill
position_monitor: persistent one-minute threshold monitor: stop/trailing/timeout use closed 1m bars; the stored Adaptive Exit V1 activation is consumed by the minute executor and is never recomputed there
